newsitem.title: USA: US securities group elects James Higgins chairman.
newsitem.headline: US securities group elects James Higgins chairman.

text.p: The Securities Industry Association (SIA), a U.S. trade group, said on Friday that James Higgins, president and chief operating officer of Dean Witter Financial, was elected to serve as its 1997 chairman.
Higgins, the SIA's current chairman-elect, will succeed A.B. Krongard, who is chairman and chief executive officer of Alex. Brown Inc. Krongard will continue as a director of the trade group.
Irving Weiser, president and chief executive officer of the Inter-Regional Financial Group Inc, was named chairman-elect.
James Brinkley, president of Legg Mason Wood Walker, and Roy Zuckerberg, a partner at Goldman Sachs & Co, were named vice chairmen.
Brinkley and Zuckerberg succeed Weiser and Bernard Madoff, principal of Bernard L. Madoff Investment Securities.
Dean Witter Financial is a unit of Dean Witter Discover & Co.
